dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single prominent white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast and moderate thickness.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, pale bluish-white boundaries are visible along the edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers against darker centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, high-contrast yellowish-white trapezoidal patch is visible on the posterior neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, distinct boundary exists between the black crown and the yellowish-white nape patch, followed by a secondary transition to the olive mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent large white cheek patch bordered by black plumage on the head and throat.
